subject: Payment routing change: escrow activation, VAT fiscal rep onboarding & bank signatory transfer
messages:
From: Marco Leone <marco.leone@velora.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@velora.com>, payments@velora.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: Request: route incoming invoices to escrow + VAT fiscal rep onboarding

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. Quick heads-up following our acquisition close last week — Velora completed the purchase of BioNova S.r.l. and, per our treasury policy, invoices for the BioNova unit now need to be routed to a new escrow account while we migrate ledgers. We also appointed a VAT fiscal representative in Italy to handle VAT reporting for the acquired business.

Can Redwood: 
- Start sending invoices for BioNova (customer code BN-AU-441) to the escrow beneficiary? We attached a short instruction PDF with the escrow account details and the routing memo.
- Accept the attached fiscal-representative authorization once signed (we’ll send the signed PDF) so the fiscal rep can receive invoices and submit VAT filings on our behalf.
- Update bank signatory records: two signatories (Marco Leone + Elena Rossi) will be authorized on the escrow account; we’ll provide KYC to match the signatory form.

Desired timeline: escrow account active for invoices dated on or after 2027-06-01. Please confirm what docs you need and whether Redwood requires a formal addendum to the MSA or a one-off remit change.

Attachments: velora_escrow_instructions.pdf (instructions + beneficiary details)

Thanks — Marco
Marco Leone
CFO, Velora Biotech
marco.leone@velora.com
+39 02 555 1234

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 16:04:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Request: route incoming invoices to escrow + VAT fiscal rep onboarding

Hi Marco — thanks for the note and congrats on closing. We can support this, and I’ve outlined a pragmatic sequence to avoid billing interruptions: 

1) Confirmation & documents we need from Velora:
   - Company registration (certificate of incorporation) for the acquiring entity or the legal owner of the escrow mandate
   - Signed fiscal representative authorization (scanned PDF)
   - Completed bank-signatory form (attached) with KYC for Marco and Elena (IDs + proof of address)

2) Redwood-side items:
   - Finance/legal will prepare an escrow addendum to the invoicing remit. We generally handle remit-only changes as an operational addendum (no change to MSA economics). If your procurement/legal prefers, we can route a DocuSign addendum.
   - We’ll need the effective date (you proposed 2027-06-01). We’ll target that date but will ask for signed docs by 2027-05-24 to allow processing.

I’ve looped in Laura (finance) and Marissa (sales ops/legal) to pick up the attachments and DocuSign routing. Laura — I attached the bank-signatory template we need populated.

Action items: Marco/Elena — please return the authorizations and KYC to this thread by EOD 24 May.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Request: route incoming invoices to escrow + VAT fiscal rep onboarding

Hi Marco / Elena,

Thanks — a couple of clarifying items from Finance to ensure correct tax treatment and bank processing: 
- Please confirm the VAT registration number for the entity that will receive invoices (we need the exact ERN/Partita IVA).
- Provide the fiscal representative company name, local contact, and their tax agent registration number. We need the signed authorization so we can address invoices to the fiscal rep where required.
- For the escrow bank: please provide the IBAN (for EUR remittances), BIC/SWIFT, and the bank’s full legal name and address.

Notes about withholding/tax: if the acquiring entity has a different tax residence, we may need a substitute W-8/W-9 or other local tax paperwork — our tax team will flag any withholding requirements once they see the documents.

Attached: bank-signatory-form.xlsx (fillable template) and a sample invoice header format we use so you can confirm how the fiscal rep name will appear on Redwood invoices.

If you’d prefer, we can run a short 20-minute call later this week to finalize details.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
